title: Mace Indicator+
description: Notifies you when you’re high enough to guarantee popping someone’s totem.
body:
# Mace Indicator

Mace Indicator Plus helps you determine when a mace attack is powerful enough to pop an opponent’s totem in a single hit. The indicator only appears when a mace is in your inventory. Once you reach the required height, a sound plays and the mace bar fills up, making it especially useful for Crystal PvP and Mace PvP.
